reports.text: On 14 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/donald-trump-vladimir-putin-y-xi-jinping-se-sentaran-a-la-misma-mesa-en-una-historica-cumbre-trilateral-el-19-de-noviembre-3601115) reported that Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping will hold a trilateral summit in Shenzhen on November 19 to address nuclear arms reduction.
On 14 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218203), a Russian state outlet, reported that the trilateral summit will take place on November 19 on the sidelines of the APEC summit.

On 14 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/putin-xi-trump-apec-summit/) reported that the summit in Shenzhen will address nuclear arms control, U.S.-Iran tensions, and global strategic stability.

On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20261114-china-to-host-first-ever-trilateral-meeting-between-trump-xi-and-putin-next-week-us-says) reported that the three leaders are scheduled to meet on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen on Thursday.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4184573-trump-to-meet-with-xi-and-putin-next-thursday-new-york-post.html) reported that US President Donald Trump will hold a trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian leader Vladimir Putin on November 19 in Shenzhen, China.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062814/) reported that the U.S., Russian, and Chinese leaders are set to meet at the APEC summit in Shenzhen to discuss a nuclear arms control agreement and Iran.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/mort-de-vladimir-poutine-en-2027-paix-en-ukraine-guerre-en-estonie-l-improbable-scenario-du-futur-brandi-par-le-think-tank-americain-rand-20261113) reported that a think tank, RAND, published a scenario including the death of Vladimir Putin in 2027, peace in Ukraine, and war in Estonia.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/14/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-des-discussions-sur-l-ukraine-ne-sont-pas-prevues-lors-de-la-rencontre-trilaterale-entre-trump-poutine-et-xi-annoncee-par-la-maison-blanche_6808609_3210.html) reported that Washington clarified that discussions at the APEC summit meeting would focus on nuclear disarmament rather than Ukraine.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/trump-xi-e-putin-vao-se-reunir-na-china-na-proxima-quinta-19-diz-casa-branca.shtml) reported that the White House announced US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese leader Xi Jinping will meet in China.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxPX1dzUndCOE42aUFUazd4SFcxMFVWUTl6VmRVOE5QR0ZjNWRXY19qWTVuRUthUXhDS3UybmZnQmFHSHVRV20wdXJwTUlKUTlGVU42N1B4bkVwSjI4bkdJeG94aFpxX01NUTdyWUJOUVZHSHlXZkxGZXlsTWhjSmUwRXoyRklMekIycXlEUk1pM1NpNjJp?oc=5), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/north-america/trump-to-have-first-trilateral-meeting-with-putin-xi-20261114-p61e4y.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/donald-trump-to-raise-nuclear-arms-cuts-with-putin-xi-on-november-19-white-house-says/article71700773.ece) reported that White House officials stated Donald Trump plans to discuss nuclear-arms cuts with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/historic-first-summit-among-trump-xi-putin-will-not-focus-on-ukraine-white-house-says/) reported that a U.S. official stated the trilateral meeting will focus on nuclear non-proliferation and the war in Iran.

On 13 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648828-trump-putin-xi-meeting-/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state outlet, reported that the leaders of Russia, China, and the US plan to meet in Shenzhen with nuclear arms control and global conflicts on the agenda.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/trump-to-hold-first-ever-joint-meeting-with-xi-and-putin-on-the-sidelines-of-apec-in-china-101794614552520.html), [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/trump-xi-putin-trilateral-summit-apec-6551001) reported that White House officials stated Trump plans to discuss nuclear arms reductions and the war in Iran.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/trump-hold-summit-xi-putin-shenzhen-thursday-ny-post-reports) reported that US President Donald Trump will hold a trilateral summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen on Thursday.

On 12 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2217395), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/12/8062593/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/89960) reported that Russian presidential aides and officials stated Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump plan to discuss Ukraine during a meeting at the APEC summit in China.

stories.title: Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Copilot recovering after global outage lasting over 24 hours
stories.label: Global Microsoft IT Outage

reports.text: On 14 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/microsoft-restablece-totalmente-su-servicio-tras-la-caida-tecnica-33130869) reported that Microsoft fully restored its service after a technical outage caused by an error during a previous network capacity expansion.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/microsoft-dice-que-restablecio-por-completo-el-servicio-tras-caida-a-nivel-mundial_0_r0vc83xCJ0.html) reported that the global outage left several products inoperative across 74 countries.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/microsoft-dice-que-restablecio-por-completo-el-servicio-tras-su-caida-a-nivel-mundial-y-alerta-por-estafas-que-buscan-aprovechar-el-caos-3601146) reported an alert regarding scams attempting to exploit the technical chaos.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/workday-outage-disrupts-11-500-businesses-worldwide-walmart-target-workers-face-payroll-and-hr-access-issues-101794666114407.html) reported that a Workday technical failure disrupted HR and payroll access for companies including Walmart and Target.

On 13 Nov 2026, [HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/microsoft-outage_n_6af6ec51e4b065342906b58b) reported that Microsoft stated it is working to recover email and other services affected in the global outage.

On 13 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/13/microsoft-restores-services-after-a-global-outage-hit-outlook-and-teams-in-more-than-70-countries?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Microsoft stated its services were recovering after a global outage that began on Thursday afternoon.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/microsoft-announces-service-restored-global-outage-over/) reported that Microsoft announced it has restored service to customers, drawing a close to a global outage.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/outlook-teams-copilot-microsoft-annonce-la-fin-de-la-panne-mondiale-apres-plus-de-24-heures-de-perturbations-20261114) reported that the American giant announced the restoration of all its services following a global disruption.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/tech/microsoft-global-outage-down-nhs-b3084951.html) reported that Microsoft stated the disruption was due to a technical issue not related to cyber or AI agents.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/14/microsoft-says-services-fully-restored-after-global-outage) reported that operations were restored to all customers and regions affected by one of the worst IT failures in years.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/technology/microsoft-says-consumer-products-fully-recovered-3725563) reported that Microsoft announced its consumer products and services fully recovered following a global outage affecting users in at least 70 countries.
On 13 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cqzjr903n01po?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that a server outage affected Microsoft services including Teams, Outlook, and Copilot.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/outlook-outage-hits-users-in-74-countries-as-microsoft-seeks-fix/) reported that an Outlook outage hit users in 74 countries while Microsoft sought alternative solutions.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/14/microsoft-outage-recovered/) reported that Microsoft stated server issues were behind the incident affecting consumer products services and ruled out AI as the cause.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/microsoft-says-consumer-products-services-recovered-still-monitoring-enterprise-services/article71701075.ece) reported that the technology giant stated it was monitoring the backlog of email messages accrued during the event before considering enterprise services.

On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/technology/20261114-microsoft-says-consumer-products-fully-recovered-business-services-improving) reported that Microsoft confirmed all services across Teams, Outlook, Copilot, and other applications fully recovered, ending the global outage.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/microsoft-outage-hits-outlook-teams-worldwide-draws-130000-us-reports/) reported that a major global Microsoft outage knocked out Outlook, Teams, and the Copilot AI assistant for businesses and government agencies across multiple regions.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/microsoft-outage-services-across-all-previously-affected-environments-restored-microsoft-365-outage-teams-outlook-101794629719606.html) reported that Microsoft stated services across all previously affected environments have been restored.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10936977) reported that Microsoft issued an apology as a global outage affecting email and office software services stretched into a second day.

On 13 Nov 2026, [HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/microsoft-outage_n_6af6ec51e4b065342906b58b), [Mail & Guardian](https://mg.co.za/news/tech/2026-11-13-microsoft-outage-disrupts-email-and-workplace-services-across-south-africa/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581230/hours-long-microsoft-outage-disrupts-businesses-and-governments-globally/) reported that Microsoft stated it was seeing improvements for Outlook email and other Microsoft 365 services following a global outage that disrupted businesses and governments.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/14/microsoft-outage-stabilizing/) reported that Microsoft stated server issues were behind the incident and that a broader rollout of software fixes was stabilizing the system.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/14/microsoft-deeply-sorry-for-global-disruption-that-could-have-billion-dollar-impact-on-australia) reported that Microsoft said it was deeply sorry for the global disruption and that services were being restored.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/global-outage-microsoft-blames-network-change-for-service-disruption/) reported that Microsoft blamed a network change for a global outage that disrupted its workplace services including Outlook and Teams.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/microsoft-outlook-outage-status-microsoft-365-services-live-updates-november-14-2026/article71700692.ece) reported that Microsoft is testing fixes, rerouting traffic, and boosting server capacity.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook) reported that Microsoft Outlook suffered a major global outage with tens of thousands of users struggling to access their email.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide) reported that the outage knocked out Outlook, Teams, and the Copilot AI assistant for businesses and government agencies worldwide.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/que-fallo-en-la-caida-de-microsoft-las-claves-en-las-24-horas-de-trabajos-de-recuperacion-33118843) reported that Microsoft attributed the global service outage to a failure during a prior capacity expansion and stated that services are generally recovering.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide) reported that Microsoft Outlook, Teams, and Copilot experienced a major global outage affecting users worldwide.

On 13 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/cqx2e0pl80gro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/outage-in-microsoft-services-affects-tens-of-thousands-of-users-9yx9g5w) reported that tens of thousands of users suffered disruptions to Microsoft's online services.

On 13 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/microsoft-outage-improvements-for-outlook-and-other-services-around-globe/PZYAOUDJKVAIRBOIGXZLIOYQMA/) reported that Microsoft achieved a broad recovery for Outlook and other global services, while visa processing, property settlements, and courts experienced disruptions.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/microsoft-atribuye-caida-global-de-sus-servicios-a-un-fallo-tecnico-anuncia-una-recuperacion-generalizada/) reported that Microsoft attributed the global service outage to a technical flaw and announced a general recovery while ruling out cybersecurity issues.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/caida-microsoft-expone-riesgo-fallos-cascada-integracion-servicios_1794596886) reported that the service interruption began at midday on Thursday and lasted more than 20 hours.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/england-health-service-triggers-contingency-microsoft-outage.1137044) reported that England's health service triggered contingency plans due to the Microsoft outage affecting Outlook and Teams.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/microsoft-says-day-long-outage-triggered-by-technical-issue-rules-out-role-of-ai-cyber-agents-101794589974056.html) reported that Microsoft stated a technical issue caused the day-long outage and ruled out the role of AI and cyber agents.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/panne-chez-microsoft-le-recit-de-24-heures-de-pagaille-dans-les-entreprises-les-hopitaux-et-les-gouvernements-du-monde-entier-20261113) reported that millions of users in enterprises, hospitals, and governments were affected by the 24-hour Microsoft outage.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044258/microsoft-deeply-sorry-as-outage-triggers-global-chaos), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/article/3374408/microsoft-deeply-sorry-global-outage-says-issue-not-caused-cyber-or-ai-agents), [Punch](https://punchng.com/microsoft-apologises-as-global-outage-disrupts-services-in-74-countries/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Microsoft apologized for the global outage and reported a broad recovery for Outlook.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/microsoft-deeply-sorry-hourslong-outage-impacts-74-countries.1137079) reported that the outage impacted 74 countries, disrupting healthcare services, corporate earnings reports, and schools.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/avanza-recuperacion-de-servicios-de-microsoft-en-norteamerica-y-europa-persisten-problemas-de-acceso/) reported that the recovery of Microsoft services in North America and Europe advanced while access problems persisted.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/13/microsoft-outage-hits-nhs-hospitals-gps-schools-and-police-across-uk) reported that the Microsoft outage caused serious and widespread disruption across the UK, affecting hospitals, general practitioners, schools, and police.

On 13 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/microsoft-rules-out-malicious-activity-as-cause-for-global-outage/a-79935611?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/microsoft-seeing-improvements-outage-causes-global-chaos.1137057) reported that Microsoft stated it was not aware of any malicious activity causing the global outage.

reports.text: On 14 Nov 2026, [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/dozens-rescued-from-water-after-cruise-ship-sinks-20261115-p61e7f.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that dozens of people were rescued from the water after a cruise ship sank following a collision with a tanker in New Orleans.

On 14 Nov 2026, [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxNZDhuVzNmcEY1UURKMFdwOE85cTRTeS1hV1gwTmd6NEZlRzhBZjlsUVFzNTdCb19QX0dSSUVBR1VjcW5KZFktTmt1OEc4QzF5SGJsbG1xNVFTRHhyMHFVbkFlUmpSeG5iUG0yME9GTXgwMU45bWdyNHB3N3kwNlRqYnEwUVg2ZVlYUmJGaERYTmlaRDNmc1Jz?oc=5), [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/14/nola-port-sues-get-control-tanker-crashed-cruise-ship-mississippi/) reported that the Port of New Orleans sued for control of the tanker that crashed into the cruise ship.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/13/rescue-underway-tanker-hits-riverboat-129-passengers-port-new-orleans/) reported that a tanker crashed into a docked American Cruise Lines boat on the Mississippi River at the Port of New Orleans.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/14/new-orleans-mississippi-river-tanker-crash-lawsuit) reported that New Orleans port officials filed a lawsuit seeking $1 million and succeeded in seizing the tanker Atlantic Asphalt.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/14/new-orleans-cruise-ship-passengers-crew-survive-crash-tanker/) reported that all passengers and crew survived the crash after a tanker apparently lost its steering.

On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/usa-all-passengers-survive-after-tanker-hits-docked-river-cruise-ship-in-new-orleans) reported that a portion of the Mississippi River remains closed following a collision between an oil tanker and a riverboat.

On 14 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/us/2026/1114/1599198-vessel-new-orleans/) reported that a tanker ship collided with a luxury paddle wheeler docked in New Orleans on the Mississippi River, causing the cruise vessel to roll over.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640266/tanker-collides-with-cruise-ship-in-new-orleans-32-hospitalised) reported that 32 people were hospitalised after a tanker collided with a cruise ship in New Orleans.

On 14 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/cruise-ship-lists-and-partially-sinks-after-tanker-collision-near-new-orleans-bridge/) reported that the cruise ship American Heritage carried about 129 passengers and was struck on the Mississippi River near the Port of New Orleans.

On 13 Nov 2026, [De Telegraaf](https://www.telegraaf.nl/buitenland/riviercruiseschip-met-150-mensen-aan-boord-kapseist-in-haven-van-new-orleans-door-aanvaring-met-tanker/164545109.html) reported that an American Cruise Lines paddlewheel river cruise ship with around 150 people on board capsized in the port of New Orleans following a collision with a tanker.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/13/rescue-efforts-under-way-after-tanker-strikes-river-cruise-boat-in-us?traffic_source=rss) reported that the American Heritage paddleboat had 129 passengers on board and was left partially submerged.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/all-us-flights-grounded-amid-cyberattack-speculation-what-we-know-so-far/) reported that US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy announced the grounding of all departing flights due to a communications issue.

On 13 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261113-us-flight-authority-orders-national-ground-stop-over-air-traffic-control-communication-issue), [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxOeFBta25Rakd3c0VBM0NUWjJzbmV2ajZwTWRtUFVTcTVzZ2otRGo0cXZSWWV0MzNBSXdmMXNzdm9SU1d1blBBNnktRlNqQmcwVUVxQzhCNERGel9ETDBHZjJwb29IYmhGX2VPNm8xeGwwU0VNajFzZnpIM19lejBOVTZrRVVjb2t4SDh3emhSZHI?oc=5), [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/faa-issues-us-national-ground-stop-on-all-flights/a-79945062?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPTTdvYllmb0pHUXVJVGNLUmFZb2I0WXpjZENubU52NW1nQlFJa1E4c3ZNTGhseUdiUzl0ZXJWa0pOSnR1ZDlRQk9FTHZlaWkyT0hLM1J3OW5tVUhIb0o4OWN5bDVVakF5T3lIanR1SVVMSkctSDlpb2loMWI2MENuWEIxTmhTcy1kZXdqSlRrdi1NMHlFSGtPRWEzdUFrMWR1c2wwNk9rRUUwOGpzajM0N1h2MndWVU9MYngyMVdudw?oc=5) reported that the Federal Aviation Administration issued a national ground stop on all departing flights due to an air traffic control communications issue.

On 14 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/13/us/markwayne-mullin-faa-ground-stop.html) reported that Homeland Security Secretary Mullin stated he did not know what caused the telecommunication outage.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/marco-rubios-memo-presented-cia-report-on-jensen-huang-in-stronger-terms-leading-to-ex-nvidia-ceos-exit-report-101794679247074.html) reported that Marco Rubio's intervention presenting a CIA report on Jensen Huang in stronger terms contributed to the former Nvidia CEO's exit.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640308/ex-nvidia-ceo-misled-top-lawyer-on-affair-with-chinese-businesswoman-sources-say) reported that the former Nvidia CEO told leaders that interactions with a Chinese businesswoman reflected standard business dealings.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/elon-musk-warns-nvidia-will-lose-critical-deals-without-jensen-huang-101794668617377.html), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/economia/con-el-apoyo-de-elon-musk-una-peticion-con-casi-90000-firmas-exige-que-jensen-huang-vuelva-a-ser-el-nid14112026/) reported that Elon Musk warned that Nvidia could lose critical deals following the exit of Jensen Huang, as a petition demanded his reinstatement.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532100/Jensen-Huang-s-exit-leaves-a-much-bigger-story-unexplained) reported that Jensen Huang built Nvidia into an essential supplier for the artificial intelligence boom and convinced Washington that U.S. leadership depended upon it.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/jensen-huang-quits-nvidia-as-scandal-rocks-ai-giant/) reported that Jensen Huang resigned as chief executive of Nvidia after revelations of two extramarital affairs.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261113008400320) reported that Nvidia confirmed its planned supply of GPUs to South Korea despite the resignation, according to the science minister.

On 13 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648799-huang-nvidia-downfall-explainer/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that an alleged Chinese spy scandal raised questions over the power struggle and the US-China AI war.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/elon-musk-backs-petition-seeking-jensen-huangs-nvidia-return-i-m-signing-it-101794624452119.html) reported that Elon Musk posted on X that a petition was underway to reinstate Jensen Huang and that he would sign it.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/technology/features/china-beauty-stratagem-new-victim-nvidia-jensen-huang/) reported that personal relationships remain a weakness that rivals can exploit as long as important decisions depend on individuals.

On 14 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/caida-hombre-nvidia-pone-prueba-alianza-trump-silicon-valley_202611146af7c6bed3bddc0868b120a2.html) reported that US President Donald Trump called Jensen Huang after an espionage scandal came to light to ask him to fight to keep his position.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/california-restaurant-removes-sign-marking-nvidia-s-founding-after-jensen-huang-exit-101794625310768.html) reported that a Denny's restaurant in San Jose, California, removed a commemorative sign celebrating Nvidia's founding following Huang's exit.

On 14 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1009462/what-we-know-about-chinese-businesswoman-alice-huang/story/) reported that Alice Huang had a long career in Chinese finance before emerging as an executive in the global artificial intelligence chip sector.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/13/nvidia-has-lost-nearly-2tn-in-value-what-could-it-be-worth-without-jensen-huang) reported that Nvidia has lost about $1.8tn in market value since its record close on October 6.

On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/can-nvidia-survive-without-tech-titan-jensen-huang) reported that computing giant Nvidia has approached Rene Haas, CEO of British chip designer Arm, in its search for a potential successor to Jensen Huang.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/arm-ceo-rene-haas-emerges-as-contender-amid-hunt-for-jensen-huangs-replacement-at-nvidia-101794635086538.html) reported that Nvidia's board stated it was in the process of selecting a search firm for the CEO role and had not formally engaged potential candidates such as British chipmaker CEO Rene Haas.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxONzdHUzc1NjBCWjJNbldoNEhWS3RkQzJNdHJGTXFfX0h0YWR5QjhHbjdkd3NENnU2eXZpMktjMWRzT216Y2tMbnB0dS04T25QZEtxQmNpZzQ2SjNXRHNwQ2h4ckdOdkJ3d19IRDBYaUs5dzZzc2o2WmliV3hnRjNSN3VyM0trT1hxMEh4M2ppd3RBQ2RXTVUtWE40MmI0S2Z1d0ZBVjZGV2FSa2tDVEpDWU02WXR0QjBOdHRmTHJRV09faXc?oc=5), [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009460/ex-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-misled-top-lawyer-on-affair-with-chinese-businesswoman-sources/story/), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/former-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-misled-top-lawyer-on-affair-with-alice-huang-report/article71700767.ece) reported that sources stated former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang misled top lawyer Tim Teter and other company leaders about his relationship with a Chinese businesswoman.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/jensen-huang-misled-nvidia-leaders-about-relationship-with-chinese-businesswoman-alice-huang-101794625800174.html) reported that Jensen Huang resigned following reports of his alleged extramarital affairs, including one with Alice Huang who is suspected of being a Chinese spy.
On 14 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2218077) reported that Elon Musk revealed preparation of a petition to reinstate Huang as Nvidia's CEO.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/14/companies/nvidia-arm-ceo-haas-huang/) reported that Nvidia's board stated it was in the process of selecting a search firm for the CEO role and had not formally engaged any potential candidates.

On 13 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/us/politics/trump-jensen-huang-nvidia.html) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump urged Nvidia's Jensen Huang to fight for his job during a telephone call.

On 13 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3374412/us-congress-widens-nvidia-probe-seeking-testimony-jensen-huang-and-trump-officials) reported that US lawmakers demanded testimony from Jensen Huang and Trump officials regarding advanced chip exports to China.
On 13 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/videos/90006) reported that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is at the center of a national security story regarding an espionage scandal.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640159/colette-kress-the-cfo-who-challenged-huangs-bets-is-nvidias-interim-ceo) reported that CFO Colette Kress has taken over as Nvidia's interim CEO after previously clashing with Huang over risky AI financing deals.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/who-is-nvidia-new-interim-ceo-colette-kress-after-jensen-huang-exit/article71696530.ece), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/affaire-nvidia-qui-est-colette-kress-la-remplacante-par-interim-de-jensen-huang-20261113) reported that 13-year Nvidia veteran Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO following Jensen Huang's exit.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/technology/jensen-huang-exit-us-scrutiny-imperil-chinese-ai-projects-reliant-nvidia/) Rappler reported that Huang's exit and US scrutiny imperil $3 billion in Chinese AI projects reliant on Nvidia.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/business/20261112-jensen-huang-resigns-as-nvidia-ceo-after-mounting-scandals) reported that Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia's President, CEO and board member.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/12/jensen-huang-nvidia-ceo-replacement) reported that Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO on a short-term basis.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-13-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-in-blow-to-ai-boom-he-helped-foster/) reported that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stepped down following revelations of extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy.

On 13 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/terremoto-politico-en-el-gobierno-de-trump-tras-la-caida-del-ceo-de-nvidia-internas-presiones-y-un-nid13112026/) reported that U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick came under scrutiny following a Chinese espionage scandal, with both political parties demanding explanations in Congress.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044316/nvidia-approached-arm-ceo-haas-to-succeed-huang-ft-reports) reported that Nvidia's board approached Arm Holdings CEO Rene Haas in its search for a potential successor to Jensen Huang.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/article-914828) reported that Nvidia employees called on the board of directors to immediately reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-amid-scandal/article71694271.ece), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/nvidia-ceo-to-resign-amid-controversy-over-alleged-extramarital-affair/) reported that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid controversy over alleged extramarital affairs and espionage claims, with CFO Colette Kress serving as interim CEO.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/trump-wants-apples-cook-to-replace-huang-as-nvidia-ceo) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump called for former Apple CEO Tim Cook to replace Jensen Huang at Nvidia.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/presidente-donald-trump-hablo-con-jensen-huang-tras-su-renuncia-como-ceo-de-nvidia-y-afirmo-que-el-empresario-esta-pasando-por-un-infierno-3600730) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump spoke with Jensen Huang after his resignation as Nvidia CEO and stated that the businessman was passing through an inferno.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/asia/reuters-revela-una-tercera-relacion-extramarital-de-jensen-huang-fundador-de-nvidia-presuntamente-con-otra-empleada-de-la-compania-esto-se-sabe-3600651), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/economia/IA/jensen-huang-el-exceo-de-nvidia-tuvo-un-amorio-con-una-segunda-empleada-de-la-empresa-segun-reuters-nid13112026/) reported that Reuters revealed a third extramarital relationship involving former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang with another company employee.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640125/us-senate-banking-committee-chair-calls-on-jensen-huang-lutnick-to-testify), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/us/2026/1113/1599069-nvidia-us/) reported that the US Senate Banking Committee chair called on Jensen Huang and Howard Lutnick to testify following Huang's resignation.

On 13 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/13/quem-pode-suceder-jensen-huang-na-nvidia-com-renuncia-do-ceo-veja-nomes-cotados-para-assumir-a-gigante-dos-chips-apos-comando-interino.ghtml) reported that Colette Kress and others were cited as potential successors to Jensen Huang at Nvidia.

On 13 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmq5vd1wdgz6o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) BBC World reported that ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was summoned to testify before Congress about an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/tech-and-start-ups/article-914815) reported that three Israeli tech leaders are among those being considered to succeed Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO.

reports.text: On 13 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxQNTZXTFM5V00xOEJZcWtJU21rRENBM2lkQ3JCQmJvbUVRSDNqeWplR0FWSk9qSWVVdDAxR295VWxLMmNKb1Z0RmZURlQ3TV9ReHVrTW1nak9IVHpCNjduUXZZTG5NQ3JhT2pTNUR1N3dtZTNoZDVwdjNKeGY1cGxvSFNsYTNMMjhyZmNENkl1SDR4cFBDNllZdWRRbHhQa3BFUS1xc2lLTkFrOXNkZDNVSnJrRi0?oc=5) reported that Democrat Holscher won the Kansas governor's race amid data center backlash.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/us-news/2026-11-14/ty-article/alaska-elects-a-democratic-governor-for-the-first-time-since-1998/000001a1-d911-da30-a7fb-d9bd00550000) reported that Jonathan Kreis-Tomkins defeated three Republicans to win the election for governor of Alaska.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNMFlrazk1QlViSjJ3ZjlhblpyOXFxT1FWZTkxSVdxc0NweEtuLUk3NDh6RkRDb1I2MVJnbG5yUm9hcmxtaHZ2VGtOT3MyaUxkSVE4MDJwMzU2NS16N2F1Tk5RLUdtaDl4TWt5NkxIT3JYZHJONGFaX3RRbXY2SW04MUc3UjhGMG1wQWtIeG91Nl9CRXRvMkdTTA?oc=5), [Politico](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/11/14/jonathan-kreiss-tomkins-wins-alaska-governor-01166573), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/14/us/elections/alaska-governor-winner-kreiss-tomkins-jkt.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/democrat-jonathan-kreiss-tomkins-wins-election-for-governor-in-alaska-101794632680893.html) reported that Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins won the election for governor of Alaska, defeating Dave Bronson and becoming the first Democrat elected to the office since 1998.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/13/mississippians-scott-colom-election) reported that Mississippians across racial lines celebrated Scott Colom becoming the state's first Black senator since Reconstruction.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/democrat-cindy-holscher-wins-kansas-governors-race-amid-datacenter-backlash-it-s-the-honor-of-a-lifetime-101794582914757.html) reported that Democrat Cindy Holscher won Kansas' governor's race after campaigning to pause data center approvals.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-scott-colom-interview-praise-b3084510.html) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump praised Mississippi's Senator-elect Scott Colom following his historic senate upset.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/historically-red-mississippi-and-alaska-win-blue-senate-seats) reported that historically red Mississippi and Alaska won blue Senate seats, breaking Republican strongholds.

On 12 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/us/kansas-governor-democrat-holscher-wins.html) reported that State Senator Cindy Holscher won the Kansas governor race, retaining the seat for Democrats.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxQdFAyRnM5T3lHNFY3S0NUd3lKQkpuZGJSdmJMMGc5aVJZanZmb2JRNjFlU1laTHp0OXJwRzZUSnRmbVlPR1J5OHp1ZUNPbDBwNm5xOEZ3N1ZRejAxNk5hU1dyWFNJdTJsZk4zaW1rbHBnODZZUUdlR0tVR0NKSlNYdTFHZ2pmRHpobUkwUzNnSENSQzlIQXJvd05TV3QtQlFLX2R6a3RNQi1DYW8?oc=5) reported that Democrat Cindy Holscher was elected Kansas' next governor.

On 12 Nov 2026, [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/g-s1-153171/up-first-newsletter-scott-colom-trump-democrats-ukraine-russia), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2026/nov/12/mississippi-scott-colom-ukraine-donald-trump) reported that Scott Colom won the Mississippi Senate race after more than a week of counting ballots.

On 12 Nov 2026, [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/g-s1-153171/up-first-newsletter-scott-colom-trump-democrats-ukraine-russia), [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648747-trump-democrats-clash-corruption-probes/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that White House counsel Will Scharf warned Democrats that their probes into Trump could lead to executive branch investigations.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxPaTRFXzVMOVNIM2JnNFFkTzlrSmVYYnV5NTJlNDVVY1FhTXVBR1QybjdUd3JoVWpvZ3NRdFVGY0FkNlRmcW96d2VTR0tYei15dnp4eEhibFF4cGhwUnJnX3gwSHU0TEU4MUx2dE40V1BBSTZQYXVqOV9Nd0pkNXk0T3JQeFJ5emx3azFxMm5kLU5FLTJVcDJ5cmhURG9RYjBMVE1vbVJ6aEJiM3otQVFtVk5Cdw?oc=5), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/us/elections/mississippi-colom-senate-race-black-voters.html), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-mississippi-elects-democrat-colom-as-state-s-first-post-civil-war-black-senator), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/scott-colom-wins-mississippi-senate-race-in-historic-upset-3725488) reported that Democrat Scott Colom won the Mississippi Senate race, becoming the state's first Black senator since the Reconstruction era or 1874.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/scott-colom-wins-mississippi-us-senate-seat-hyde-smith/) reported that Scott Colom defeated Republican Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith 49.2% to 48.7%.

On 12 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/mississippi-senate-race-democrat-scott-colom-defeats-republican-cindy-hyde-smith/a-79924938?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Democrat Scott Colom defeated Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith in the Mississippi Senate race.
On 12 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/mississippis-scott-colom-flips-us-senate-seat-democrat) reported that Scott Colom flipped a US Senate seat to the Democrats in Mississippi.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/mississippi-democrat-flips-us-senate-seat-historic-upset.1136956) reported that senator-elect Scott Colom waved during the conclusion of a victory rally at Tougaloo College.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/mississippi-elege-democrata-scott-colom-primeiro-senador-negro-pelo-estado-dos-eua-em-150-anos.shtml) reported that Democrat Scott Colom won a seat in the United States Senate for Mississippi, becoming the first Black politician to win the seat in 150 years.
On 12 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/11/11/scott-colom-wins-mississippi-senate-01161555) reported that Democrat Scott Colom won the Mississippi Senate race in an upset.

On 12 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cjy5x42p3qzko?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Scott Colom’s victory makes him the first Black person elected to the US Senate from Mississippi in over 140 years.
On 12 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/us/elections/hyde-smith-concedes-senate-colom.html) reported that Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith conceded the race to Scott Colom.
On 12 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/us/elections/colom-mississippi-senate-democrats.html) reported that Colom’s victory gives Democrats 55 seats in the Senate.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.com/video/2026/11/11/business-leaders-and-washington-prepare-for-a-democratic-congress-2227260) reported that business leaders and Washington are preparing for a Democratic Congress.

On 11 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/us/democratic-dark-money-super-pac-complaint.html) reported that a new Democratic-tied dark-money group is drawing scrutiny over its midterm spending.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/eisenkot-acusa-netanyahu-de-promover-racismo-contra-os-partidos-arabes.shtml) reported that Gadi Eisenkot accused Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu of promoting racism against Arab parties.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640257/netanyahu-discusses-possible-resumption-of-attacks-on-iran-with-eisenkot-israeli-media), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/netanyahu-talks-possible-resumption-of-iran-attacks-with-eisenkot-israeli-media-3725556) reported that Israeli media outlets stated Benjamin Netanyahu discussed the possible resumption of attacks on Iran with Gadi Eisenkot.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/iran/2026-11-13/ty-article/.premium/mossad-chief-meets-u-s-officials-to-discuss-iran-as-netanyahu-pushes-for-war/000001a1-d57c-da30-a7fb-ddfd4a810000), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914818) reported that Mossad Director Gofman visited Washington, meeting the CIA director while Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pushed to resume fighting against Iran.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/eisenkot-netanyahus-campaign-against-arabs-is-racist-he-says/) reported that prime ministerial hopeful Gadi Eisenkot accused caretaker Netanyahu of running a racist campaign against Arabs.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/israel-gadi-eisenkot-accuse-benyamin-netanyahou-de-mener-une-campagne-raciste-contre-la-minorite-arabe-20261113), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/13/israel-gadi-eisenkot-denonce-une-campagne-raciste-de-benyamin-netanyahou-contre-la-minorite-arabe_6809358_3210.html) reported that Gadi Eisenkot accused Benjamin Netanyahu of conducting a racist campaign against the Arab minority.

On 13 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/13/world/middleeast/eisenkot-netanyahu-racism-arabs.html) reported that Eisenkot criticized Netanyahu days after the Israeli leader attacked Arab lawmakers in a speech.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-israels-eisenkot-denounces-racist-hostile-campaign-against-arab-citizens-cites-progress-in-coalition-talks/) reported that Eisenkot cited progress in coalition talks while denouncing the campaign.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-914820) reported that Gadi Eisenkot backed MK Elisaf Peretz amid tensions over Arab party involvement in future coalitions.

reports.text: On 13 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/scott-bessent-confirms-relocating-from-washington-home-to-military-base-amid-iranian-threats-101794581505450.html), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/american-politics/article-914821) reported that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confirmed relocating from his Washington home to a military base following Iranian threats.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/nov/13/us-terror-case-raf-fairford-arrests) reported that a suspect held in a New York jail has been linked to a handler behind Iran-linked operations in Britain in connection with the RAF Fairford arrests.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/11/12/3-iranian-backed-men-indicted-in-attempted-plot-on-raf-fairford/) reported that three men, with one working from jail, allegedly conspired to commit around 20 terrorist attacks across the US and Europe, including a plot on RAF Fairford.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914783) reported that a 41-year-old US Army officer stationed at NATO headquarters in the UK was arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1579836/us-authorities-charge-three-men-over-suspected-terror-plot-targeting-raf-fairford/) reported that United States authorities unsealed an eight-count indictment charging three men for involvement in foreign terror plots targeting RAF Fairford.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/coded-messages-from-jail-cell-how-alleged-iranian-operative-mohammad-dawood-al-saadi-coordinated-foiled-raf-fairford-terror-plot-uk-us-iran-war-101794386640896.html) reported that American and British authorities suspected an Iranian link to the foiled terror plot, while Tehran denied any involvement.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-charges-3-alleged-iran-operatives-for-targeting-raf-fairford-in-uk-20-other-terror-plots-101794384900293.html) reported that US prosecutors charged three alleged operatives for targeting RAF Fairford in the UK and other terror plots.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/11/us-charges-three-men-for-allegedly-plotting-attack-on-uk-base?traffic_source=rss) reported that the US charged three men for allegedly plotting an attack on a Royal Air Force base in Fairford, UK.

On 10 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-charges-3-alleged-iranian-operatives-over-plots-targeting-jewish-communities-and-a-uk-airbase/a-79913543?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that US prosecutors claimed three alleged Iranian operatives were planning a campaign of terror against Jewish communities and a UK airbase.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1579406/us-withdraws-aircraft-from-second-uk-military-base/) reported that the United States moved at least 10 military aircraft from RAF Mildenhall following an alleged threat linked to Iran.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-relocates-military-aircraft-from-british-base-amid-iran-threats-101794324495306.html) reported that the U.S. Air Force relocated 13 aircraft from RAF Mildenhall to bases in Scotland, Spain, and Germany after identifying a threat.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/189962/%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B3%D8%A8%D8%A7-%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%A5%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B4%D9%86%D8%B7%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%AD%D8%A8-12-%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9) reported that the US military withdrew at least 12 refueling aircraft from a British military base due to an Iranian threat.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/us-evacuates-aircraft-from-british-military-base-after-threat-from-iran-wsj-reports/) reported that the United States evacuated American military aircraft from a base in England following a threat from Iran, according to The Wall Street Journal.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/us-withdraws-military-aircraft-second-uk-airbase) reported that Sky News stated 12 aircraft left Mildenhall on Monday based on flight tracking sources.

On 10 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3373947/us-withdraws-9-military-aircraft-second-uk-airbase-after-iran-threat-reports) reported that the United States withdrew military aircraft from a second British airbase following a threat from Iran, according to the Wall Street Journal.
On 10 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/10/world/us-uk-base-evacuated-iran/) reported that US aircraft were evacuated from a second UK base due to an Iran threat.

stories.title: Indonesia: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resignation and Political Turmoil

reports.text: On 13 Nov 2026, [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/indonesian-vice-president-says-resignation-unrelated-to-scrutiny-of-educational-credentials/) reported that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka stated his resignation was unrelated to the scrutiny of his educational credentials.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/13/asia-pacific/politics/prabowo-consolidates-power/) reported that Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto has increasingly put his own stamp on the government since taking office.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/indonesian-vice-president-submits-resignation-amid-school-credentials-controversy/) reported that the controversy is connected to a widening rift between President Prabowo Subianto and his predecessor Joko Widodo.

On 12 Nov 2026, [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE1XcTVMMmRlWnlGcXJzVUFKUDRpX0FqTmc3RjFhd2RuUGJOdTFpM2g5dVc0YmlMZUtoWGcxQUdlVU5DdThKWjkxS3ppWW1MM0o4SGNMZlpoWDVqTUlkc29VZkJDdTVTZElJV043RlpsNHNKaENHX2xZRDNZdWU?oc=5), [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/g-s1-153190/indonesias-vp-resigns-as-his-eligibility-and-academic-credentials-are-questioned), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/13/indonesia-vice-president-diploma-resignation-explained) reported that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned following questions regarding his academic credentials and eligibility.

On 12 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-gibran-vice-president-jokowi-prabowo-6541991) reported that analysts stated Gibran's exit as Indonesia's vice president could let President Prabowo further consolidate his influence.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1580374/indonesian-vice-president-gibran-rakabuming-raka-submits-resignation-to-parliament/) reported that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka formally submitted his resignation to parliament's upper house in Jakarta.

On 12 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009283/indonesia-vp-hands-resignation-to-parliament-as-dad-jokowi-backs-prabowo/story/) reported that Indonesia VP Gibran Rakabuming Raka handed his resignation to parliament following a push by lawmakers for his impeachment.

On 12 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmvgxgz87qqro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Indonesia's vice-president resigned amid signs that the ruling alliance with President Prabowo is fraying.

On 12 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/world/asia/indonesia-gibran-vice-president-resign.html) reported that Gibran Rakabuming Raka stepped down amid a scandal over his academic credentials.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/12/indonesian-vp-resigns-over-education-qualification-row?traffic_source=rss) reported that Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned over a dispute regarding his educational qualifications.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/442051/gibran-resigns-as-vice-president-letter-gives-no-reason-mpr) reported that Indonesia's People's Consultative Assembly Speaker Ahmad Muzani disclosed that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka submitted his resignation letter without giving a reason.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441975/gibran-resignation-would-halt-120-lawmaker-impeachment-motion) reported that Gibran's resignation would halt a 120-lawmaker impeachment motion.

On 12 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3374164/gibran-officially-resigns-indonesias-vice-president-after-degree-scandal) reported that Gibran officially resigned as Indonesia's vice-president following a scandal over his high school diploma.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxPOTZ0Q3FKQkpsRnZBSlJKMHFqS3d1QV9qTXp5aUpidXh5eEF3amd5aWh0YUFfbnJHYVQ4c29LaVRQTDJKbkRiUHBuTERNU1RuRnJ4dlFGdlY2ZWJIYjN1RmRQeUF6bkNITTFjQ2tUWlpUQWJqd3ZFQ1FOSnR4MkRzSm5uaDVoSjlOZVgwUHRkX1JCVTItVE1NUnVIQjZxcTd0N3V2NDUxSm9aUldEUWZQeVB6WGIxT0lQTE5QY2F4SG9PaTgxRGZkcnNB?oc=5) reported that over 100 Indonesian lawmakers signed a petition demanding the vice president's impeachment.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441795/all-house-factions-submit-proposal-to-impeach-vp-gibran) reported that all political party factions in Indonesia's House of Representatives submitted a formal Right to Express proposal to impeach Vice President Gibran.

On 11 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-petition-vp-gibran-rakabuming-raka-impeachment-6542386) reported that over 100 Indonesian lawmakers signed a petition stating that Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka no longer meets the requirements of his post.

On 11 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374034/indonesian-vp-resignation-drama-raises-stakes-prabowo-alliances-strain) reported that the prospect of Gibran Rakabuming Raka stepping down as Indonesia's vice-president has raised the stakes for President Prabowo Subianto.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441679/govt-assures-no-vice-presidential-vacancy-yusril) reported that Coordinating Minister for Law, Human Rights, Immigration and Correctional Affairs Yusril Ihza Mahendra assured there is no vice presidential vacancy.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441647/gibran-joins-prabowo-at-palace-after-expressing-intention-to-resign) reported that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka attended a National Heroes Day award ceremony at the State Palace after expressing his intention to resign.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441639/gibran-seeks-chance-to-prove-validity-of-diploma-through-court-process) reported that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka asked President Prabowo Subianto for an opportunity to prove the validity of his diploma through court.

stories.title: Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools
stories.label: Italy School Bomb Threats

reports.text: On 12 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr894w453e90o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that schools across Italy received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking evacuations.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovi-allarmi-bomba-in-3.800-scuole-ma-si-resta-in-classe_8e554317-0de6-4431-82f1-76e9da9afb9d.html) reported that new bomb alarms hit 3,800 schools in Italy while classes continued.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQSFJJaFJoR2JHVWdTZmVzdkw2MDhTc29qU0pDRmdmaXpwWjN2Q3VyYjlFUWJkRmJHTmlaNFFYdWIxdTFHR3p5VGlTaGExYzFwZ3BTRjV6dTJuQWdibllJN1lwd3E1RThuUEU2ekpfbU1GSUJwU2tyMkd5a3daSEkwNm5YU19zUEIxLWpSNjNDS0lzT1NCd2ZQRG1COA?oc=5), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/italian-schools-hit-by-fresh-bomb-threats-premiers-office-targeted-3725511) reported that Italian schools remained open despite a fresh wave of email bomb threats that led to evacuations and security inspections in several regions.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/italy-hit-by-second-day-of-school-bomb-threats-as-meloni-summons-opposition) reported that bomb threats hit schools in Italy and France, and French President Emmanuel Macron stated it is too soon to blame foreign powers.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/politica/2026/11/12/nel-pomeriggio-riunione-tecnica-sul-protocollo-di-gestione-degli-allarmi_935b5bfb-8d1b-47fb-b1f5-5bec809755af.html) reported that an official circular was issued to schools stating that evacuations should not occur in the absence of concrete dangers, while prefects retain the authority to order them.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovo-allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-controlli-e-evacuazioni-liveblog_97a3c6b7-93f4-44a2-940b-dd33198f2f91.html) reported that a new bomb alarm hit schools across various regions via emails signed by Mikhail Andropov.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-hybrid-warfare-hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-to-schools-in-italy-uk-in-latest-disruption) reported that hoax bomb alerts were sent to schools in Italy and the UK.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-thousands-of-schools-evacuated-in-italy-as-bomb-threats-spread-across-europe) reported that thousands of schools were evacuated across Italy following a series of hoax bomb threats.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-schools-italy-uk-and-ireland-latest-disruption) reported that schools across Italy were evacuated after around 6,300 of them received bomb warnings.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/hoax-bomb-threats-target-italys-schools-with-over-300-evacuated) reported that Italian authorities evacuated hundreds of schools following a bomb threat sent via email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/11/les-ecoles-italiennes-irlandaises-et-ecossaises-visees-par-des-alertes-a-la-bombe_6809033_3210.html) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland received threatening emails.

On 11 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/videogallery/italia/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-italiane-evacuazioni-a-roma-milano-liguria-e-venezia_7aa42fc1-bbfb-4057-a24a-320286389ef8.html) reported bomb alarms across Italian schools with evacuations in Rome, Milan, Liguria, and Venice.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/11/11/tysiachi-shkol-v-italii-velikobritanii-i-irlandii-poluchili-soobshcheniia-s-ugrozami-vzryva-news) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Great Britain, and Ireland received false bomb threat messages.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/centenas-de-escolas-na-italia-irlanda-do-norte-e-escocia-recebem-ameacas-de-bomba-alunos-sao-retirados.shtml) reported that hundreds of schools across Italy received bomb threats by email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/amenazas-falsas-de-bomba-siguen-alertando-a-europa-italia-irlanda-y-reino-unido-desalojan-escuelas-ante-presuntas-amenazas-3600148) reported that false bomb threats also alerted schools in the UK and Ireland, prompting evacuations.

On 11 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-in-oltre-6000-scuole-in-italia-evacuazioni-e-controlli.-meloni-grande_870b0024-72d2-4b15-bab5-0c74dcc1d653.html) reported that false bomb threats sent via an anonymous email led to evacuations and controls in over 6,000 schools in Italy.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/threatening-hoax-messages-sent-hundreds-schools-italy-uk-ireland.1136937) reported that threatening hoax messages were sent to hundreds of schools in Italy, the UK, and Ireland.

On 11 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwz0k79pr8z2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that false warnings containing bomb threats were sent via email to schools in Rome, Naples, Vicenza, Florence, Pisa, Trieste, and other Italian cities.

On 11 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/giorgia-meloni-italian-milan-antonio-tajani-rome-b3083120.html) reported that Italian authorities evacuated around 300 schools after receiving bomb threats via email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3374103/over-300-italian-schools-evacuated-after-receiving-same-emailed-bomb-alert) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving the same bomb alert message.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bomb-threat-emails-trigger-evacuation-of-300-schools-across-italy-101794396853871.html) reported that bomb threat emails triggered the evacuation of 300 schools across Italy amid rising concerns over hybrid warfare threats.
On 11 Nov 2026, [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23911182) reported that around 300 schools in Italy received bomb threats sent via email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [De Telegraaf](https://www.telegraaf.nl/buitenland/bommeldingen-op-honderden-scholen-in-italie-ierland-en-schotland/164394527.html) reported that hundreds of schools were evacuated in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland following anonymous bomb threat emails.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/vuelven-evacuar-cientos-escuelas-italia-falsas-amenazas-bomba-segunda-vez-mes_0_7GXzyxNE7g.html) reported that hundreds of schools in Italy were evacuated for the second time in less than a month following anonymous emails containing bomb threats directed at principals.

On 11 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/11/pais-correm-para-buscar-filhos-apos-ameacas-de-bomba-em-ao-menos-312-escolas-na-italia-governo-descarta-perigo-iminente.ghtml) reported that at least 312 institutions were affected by the sequence of bomb threats against Italian schools, causing anxiety among parents.

On 11 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914575) reported that at least 300 Italian schools were evacuated after receiving email bomb alerts signed by Mikhail Andropov.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d8%a5%d9%8a%d8%b7%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%8a%d8%a7-%d8%a5%d8%ae%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%a1-%d8%a3%d9%83%d8%ab%d8%b1-%d9%85%d9%86-300-%d9%85%d8%af%d8%b1%d8%b3%d8%a9-%d8%a8%d8%b3%d8%a8%d8%a8-%d8%b1%d8%b3%d8%a7%d8%a6) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving identical emails warning of bombs inside educational institutions.

reports.text: On 14 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86321499/Iran-seeks-fair-treatment-on-nuclear-rights-sovereignty-over), an Iranian state outlet, reported that Vice President for Legal Affairs Majid Ansari stated Iran seeks fair treatment on nuclear rights and territorial sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261114-un-warns-of-rising-maritime-attacks-urges-restoration-of-safe-navigation-in-strait-of-hormuz-red-sea/) reported that a UN official warned that growing attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab threaten international trade.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532150/Iran-downs-17th-US-MQ-1-drone-reports-two-tankers-hit-by-sea), a state-media outlet, reported that the Islamic Revolution Guard Corps shot down another US drone over the Persian Gulf and that two tankers were hit by sea mines.

On 14 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218199), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261114-irans-revolutionary-guard-says-it-shot-down-us-drone-over-qeshm-island/) reported that Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps stated it shot down a US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/iran-strait-of-hormuz-oil-tanker-fire-b3084956.html) reported that tankers in recent weeks have attempted to navigate what were described as unauthorised routes in the waterway.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/irans-irgc-claims-it-shot-down-us-mq-1-predator-drone-over-qeshm-island-101794659260137.html) reported that the IRGC claimed it had shot down a US MQ-1 Predator drone over Qeshm Island.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/iran-reports-three-oil-tankers-hit-mines-in-hormuz-3725562) reported that Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy stated two oil tankers struck naval mines and caught fire in the southern Strait of Hormuz.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxOWVUydG1mRVVtRzVScWR6N19NejF5VXVuUDlqaGxSSHdJN1hmYlBtZHRJMDNWbUJVSUMyRTBRM252dzFjSmtZOHlLYmg4Y2pqLXVrSndiS3dVLWVBa0tESWJtZW05MUprVkpXTE5sQXV0aXJRR1dQQ3FmWHk0SHpoSmQzRUZmRFZCaXdjLURicWxtRk1tSnZ1dEM2UTI1b1RmTzdwRw?oc=5), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/14/iran-war-live-irgc-strait-of-hormuz/), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86320921/Two-offending-oil-tankers-catch-fire-after-hitting-naval-mines) reported that the Iranian Revolutionary Guards Corps Navy announced two oil tankers caught fire after hitting sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249379/Oil-tanker-catches-fire-after-hitting-sea-mine-in-east-Hormuz), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86321078/Violating-oil-tanker-hit-by-mine-east-of-Strait-of-Hormuz) reported that an oil tanker in violation of regulations struck a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz and burst into flames.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581231/centcom-says-it-shot-down-two-iranian-drones-heading-towards-bahrain/) reported that CENTCOM denied Iran's claim of attacking a US early-warning radar in Bahrain and stated its forces shot down two one-way attack drones.

On 13 Nov 2026, [HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/united-states-military-downs-2-iranian-attack-drones-iran-claims-strike-american-radar-bahrain_n_6af71b02e4b065342906cbdd) reported that neither Iran's claim of striking the radar nor its account of the tanker incident could be independently verified.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532104/Bahrain-in-focus-as-Iran-targets-US-radar-downs-MQ-1-drone), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's Armed Forces announced the destruction of a US early-warning radar installation in Bahrain and the downing of an American MQ-1 drone.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/us-denies-irans-claim-it-attacked-early-warning-radar-bahrain), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/centcom-denies-iranian-claim-of-striking-us-radar-in-bahrain-3725544), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-centcom-denies-iranian-claim-of-attack-on-us-radar-in-bahrain-says-2-drones-shot-down/) reported that the U.S. Central Command denied Iranian claims of attacking an early-warning radar installation in Bahrain and stated that two one-way attack drones were shot down.

On 13 Nov 2026, [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Iran-Says-Gas-Tanker-Hit-Mine-in-Strait-of-Hormuz.html) reported that a tanker carrying liquefied gas hit a mine and suffered an explosion while attempting to transit the Strait of Hormuz via an unauthorized route.

On 13 Nov 2026, [RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/iran-us-sirik-bahrain-war-nuclear-talks/33897951.html) reported that Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps claimed it destroyed a US military early-warning radar in Bahrain.

On 13 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2217633) reported that the IRGC Navy stated an LNG carrier attempted to transit under the cover of US fighter jets before hitting a mine in the Strait of Hormuz.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxQcDQ2cWxyeTFpazFaX1ZNM2RoS0t2ZVpEa0JpMElTZVFMUElROEF5c20tMlU0dEszWFlEdkhfR2VOb3hEQmo3MjRtdVlSaEhkZnpKXzExbE5QcXItQ3Z6REoyY1Fpak9IUUplYWp6NTQ2UjBiNVk1WDN0MmJjaFRkOHNLdDYxMU9xOWhuMnVaTlNiVXJNTlhLYV9EZEpnd1oxYmF0cG82b2VkMURkYnkzZkZBX0hhWHM?oc=5) reported that Iran stated four tankers were struck by explosions in the Strait of Hormuz.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxOMXJTcEdfVGdOV1VrbGpYTy1hMlkybS1IbjZGS0piS01yNWY5RnVsMi16ZHBMTFVIajNzcFoydFZXWmhEQXJuVXBHNFBic2JSRlJLZ05TNGlmclRmMlppOExmc2ttem1zVnhQV0ppcnVaUkd2Q29fVVNXUzJpUFEwUE1WSHVkc0tZQXpmaHBSZ0YxVWpoOGNkMmZnbw?oc=5), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/13/irgc-says-it-destroyed-us-radar-in-bahrain-after-attack-on-southern-iran), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-iran-claims-it-destroyed-us-early-warning-radar-in-bahrain/), [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/iran-showcases-missiles-as-military-targets-us-army-radar-in-bahrain/) reported that Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps stated its forces targeted and destroyed a US early-warning radar installation in Bahrain.
