stories.title: Pope Leo urges end to violence in Peru during visit to remote Andes town
stories.label: Pope Leo XIV visit to Peru

reports.text: On 14 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/pope-leo-urges-end-to-violence-in-peru-during-visit-to-remote-andes-town?traffic_source=rss) reported that Pope Leo XIV urged people not to respond to injustice with brutality during a visit to Santa Cruz de Succhabamba.

On 14 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/pope-leo-xiv-cajamarca/), a state-run outlet, reported that Pope Leo XIV concluded a 300-year jubilee in Cajamarca with a call for unity.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/papa-leon-xiv-pide-en-los-andes-de-peru-no-ceder-a-la-violencia-que-desplaza-a-las-comunidades-rurales-33135140) reported that Pope Leo XIV asked people in the Peruvian Andes not to yield to violence that displaces rural communities.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/pais/monsenor-ticona-llega-este-sabado-peru-reunirse-papa-leon-xiv_1794686181) reported that Monsignor Ticona arrived in Peru to meet with Pope Leo XIV.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/alerta-por-sarampion-en-sudamerica-en-plena-visita-del-papa-leon-que-reune-multitudes-uruguay-argentina-y-peru-refuerzan-vacunacion/) reported there is a measles alert in South America during the Pope's visit, with Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru reinforcing vaccination.

On 14 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/leon-xiv-se-interno-en-una-remota-localidad-en-medio-de-los-andes-y-pidio-luchar-contra-la-justicia-nid14112026/) reported that Pope Leo XIV travelled to a remote Andean locality where he celebrated a mass and recalled his years as a missionary.

On 14 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/sociedad/leon-xiv-voz-trabajo-digno-peruanos_202611146af89d094196933d7edd6c66.html) reported that Robert Prevost presided over a mass during his second day in Chiclayo.

On 14 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/pope-leo-xiv-chiclayo/), a state-run outlet, reported that Pope Leo XIV visited Chiclayo to crown the Virgin Immaculate, marking his return to the diocese he served for eight years.

On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/half-a-million-people-gather-for-an-open-air-mass-by-pope-leo-in-peru) reported that half a million people gathered for an open-air mass led by Pope Leo XIV in Chiclayo during his South America tour.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/papa-leon-xiv-duerme-chiclayo-mismo-lugar-obispo_1794656193) reported that Pope Leo XIV stayed at the Episcopal Residence in Chiclayo, which served as his home from 2015 to 2023.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Diario Co Latino](https://www.diariocolatino.com/papa-inicia-jornada-con-una-misa-multitudinaria-en-anorada-chiclayo/) reported that Pope Leo XIV led a mass that gathered over one million faithful in Chiclayo.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxOejU1WlA1TVEtUUMwTVd1Zmw1RGhkVmFXM3p0QUxSZDZINExaSWpOc1Z1dDJ4OER2Q19LTVdqT0ZKQ1FyTXJNdnptMURsOGhsOXM4clJhVjVQazFLNS1TTXppLV8yRXZQM2xPMEpOdGNVYzF4Vi15YkluSkt1dDRMNk1xZ1lMTzF5V1VlLWh3VmkxLXpXQzZNa29wTGw3VUJVMTloekpB?oc=5) reported that huge crowds and low vaccination rates raised measles alarms as Pope Leo XIV visited South America.
On 14 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/pope-welcomes-over-one-million-faithful-in-chiclayo-peru-crowd/) reported that Pope Leo XIV welcomed over one million faithful in a crowd in northern Peru.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El País](https://english.elpais.com/international/2026-11-12/pope-leo-xiv-in-lima-wars-demand-diplomacy-that-respects-international-law.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV stated in Lima that wars demand diplomacy that respects international law.

On 12 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/pope-leo-urges-unity-in-lima-peru/) reported that Pope Leo XIV urged Peruvians to confront poverty, insecurity, and inequality together.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/13/pope-leo-cheered-on-return-to-peru-city-where-he-served-as-bishop?traffic_source=rss) reported that an estimated 1.5 million people welcomed Pope Leo XIV back to the city in Peru where he once served as bishop.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/papa-leon-xiv-visita-la-iglesia-que-ayudo-a-reconstruir-de-nuevo-en-chiclayo-33120134), [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/leon-xiv-regresa-a-chiclayo-la-ciudad-que-fue-su-casa-durante-ocho-anos-entre-muestras-de-carino-una-multitudinaria-misa-y-un-emotivo-reencuentro-3600932), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-dia-que-el-papa-leon-xiv-volvio-a-ser-el-padre-roberto-en-chiclayo-nid13112026/) reported that Pope Leo XIV visited Chiclayo on the final leg of his South America tour.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El País](https://english.elpais.com/international/2026-11-12/pope-leo-xiv-in-lima-wars-demand-diplomacy-that-respects-international-law.html), [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/pope-leo-urges-unity-in-lima-peru/) reported that Pope Leo XIV urged diplomacy and unity during his stop in Peru.

On 13 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/mundo-e-ciencia/2026/11/7322166-papa-diz-que-saude-esta-melhorando-em-retorno-a-chiclayo-no-peru.html), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/americas/2026/11/13/pope-leo-speaks-of-time-of-trial-on-return-to-peru/) reported that Pope Leo XIV stated his health is improving and described his recent lung cancer surgery as a time of trial during his return to Chiclayo.

On 13 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/vaticano/notizie/2026/11/13/il-papa-a-chiclayo-una-benedizione-per-me-essere-di-nuovo-qui_989723f9-9cc6-414d-b526-71f5586301fc.html) reported that crowds gathered in Chiclayo to welcome Pope Leo XIV back to his former diocese where he previously served as bishop.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/pais/primera-dama-invita-papa-leon-xiv-visitar-bolivia-seria-bendicion-historica_1794573495) reported that Bolivia's First Lady Bibi Urquidi invited Pope Leo XIV to visit Bolivia.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/america/2026-11-13/el-papa-leon-xiv-se-reencuentra-con-su-pueblo-de-chiclayo.html), [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/papa-leon-xiv-celebro-misa-ante-900000-personas-en-chiclayo), [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/papa-leon-xiv-parte-chiclayo-ciudad-fue-obispo-8-anos_1794576951) reported that Pope Leo XIV travelled to Chiclayo, where he previously served as bishop, and celebrated a mass.

On 13 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/leon-xiv-cumplio-su-sueno-y-regreso-con-gloria-a-la-ciudad-donde-fue-obispo-que-alegria-volver-a-nid13112026/) reported that the Pope stated he is superating his health problems.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/papa-llega-a-chiclayo-para-encontrarse-con-su-antigua-diocesis-oficiara-una-misa-multitudinaria/), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/papa-leon-xiv-llego-chiclayo-primer-bano-masas-peru-misa-multitudinaria-calor-sofocante_0_1uwSRbAGCW.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV arrived in Chiclayo to visit his former diocese and officiate a mass.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxQWk5iX2FvNmgxVVFnLWFNbC1JSkRqcmVPU0otM3ZMcVBOLUVRYWluMHVTQmdueE9qTDltMmhWbUZ2YmN4WTlCLTBNaVUyNmlweHR4TWF2aTZoTVJmN0FmeTljYWppUjVBcGVCNU01a1g5UWxQSXVWQXlIV0ZNYlByazg5Rzc2TkktZk0xWGZJVEVpZG15Ri1FTHQza3RyUTNmbkRUcjRZaFdGOUc2bm15SGdRcnFVdWloU2c?oc=5) reported that Pope Leo XIV met with abuse victims in Peru and considered changes in how the Church treats them.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/invade-papamania-a-peru-miles-de-fieles-caminan-para-recibir-a-leon-xiv-en-su-antigua-diocesis/) reported that thousands of the faithful walked through the deserts of Peru to attend a mass celebrated by Pope Leo XIV in the Pampas de Pimentel.

On 13 Nov 2026, [AMAP (Mali)](https://amap.ml/2026/11/13/amerique-latine-le-pape-leon-xiv-en-visite-au-perou-apres-des-etapes-en-uruguay-et-en-argentine/), a state outlet, reported that Pope Leo XIV visited Peru following stops in Uruguay and Argentina.

On 13 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/sign-of-hope-pope-tells-perus-youth/) reported that Pope Leo XIV urged young Peruvians to embrace hope, pursue vocations, and build meaningful friendships during a vigil attended by 60,000 people in Lima.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/keiko-fujimori-viajara-a-china-y-no-estara-en-la-despedida-del-papa-leon-xiv-en-peru-presidenta-responde-a-criticas-y-niega-un-desplante-3600408) reported that Keiko Fujimori will travel to Asia and not be present at the farewell of Pope Leo XIV in Peru.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/america/2026-11-13/leon-xiv-congrega-a-mas-de-50000-jovenes-peruanos-en-un-estadio-de-futbol-apasionense-por-todo-lo-que-merece-la-pena.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV gathered over 50,000 young Peruvians in a football stadium during his visit before traveling to Chiclayo.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPSUFHUkI5Y1p6WVhYVWZmYTEwWjVPa2FjaHlEazlGUjNkX1dWbGw3ZzgyekFjc1JPTWRLcGk3bDFfUHNyM1c1Q3NHXzE2S1BfT0xzRjI5dkVzVlI3ZXIxUHhIaVNYZXUwVldQVXBSVGI3ZFpUdDZuLTE4dHZyZ1VRMXNQZXB4YlFaeDloZENzOWk2cFIteTVzbg?oc=5) reported that Pope Leo XIV denounced 'machismo' and demanded women be protected during his return to Peru.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/13/pope-leo-xiv-warns-on-pressures-facing-modern-families?traffic_source=rss) reported that Pope Leo XIV warned that digital technology risks replacing genuine human interaction.

On 13 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261113-peruvians-flock-to-see-pope-leo-xiv-in-city-he-served-as-bishop), [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/gather-chiclayo-for-pope-leo-xivs-mass/) reported that crowds gathered early in Peru's northern city of Chiclayo ahead of Pope Leo's arrival for a Mass.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/spotlight/20261112-peruvian-pope-leo-xiv-comes-home-to-a-country-that-shaped-his-life-and-faith-through-hardship) reported that Victor Casallo discussed Pope Leo XIV returning to Peru.
On 13 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/pope-leo-chiclayo-mass-pimentel-friday-2026/) reported that Pope Leo XIV returned to Chiclayo for a Mass at Pimentel.

On 13 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261113-pope-leo-xiv-meets-abuse-victims-in-peru-says-church-must-make-amends), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1113/1599059-pope-south-america/) reported that Pope Leo met six victims of clerical abuse in Peru, including people linked to the disbanded Sodalitium Christianae Vitae.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/arzobispo-de-lima-comparte-con-leon-xiv-el-caso-de-jovenes-martires-en-protestas-en-peru-33108606) reported that the Archbishop of Lima shared the case of young martyrs in protests in Peru with Leo XIV.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/13/peru-pope-leo-xiv-leads-youth-prayer-vigil-at-limas-national-stadium), [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/13/leo-xiv-to-52-000-young-people-in-lima-be-passionate-about-everything-worthwhile?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Pope Leo XIV led a prayer vigil with thousands of young people at Lima's National Stadium.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-peruvian-pope-makes-jubilant-return-to-his-second-homeland) reported that Pope Leo XIV arrived in Peru for a nostalgic return to the nation where he spent two decades as a missionary.

On 12 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/12/leo-xiv-arrives-in-peru-his-homeland-defending-international-law-and-reconciliation?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1580373/pope-leo-xiv-receives-massive-welcome-from-millions-upon-return-to-peru/) reported that Pope Leo XIV arrived in Lima to begin a six-day visit to Peru.

reports.text: On 14 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/us-now-focused-on-facilitating-direct-engagement-between-russia-europe-kushner-says-after-ukraine-peace-talks/) reported that U.S. envoy Jared Kushner stated the current focus is on facilitating direct engagement between Moscow and European partners and preparing the agenda for trilateral talks.
On 14 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218233), a Russian state outlet, reported that U.S. President Donald Trump emphasized the need for actionable conflict prevention mechanisms.

On 14 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218187) reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated Russia is unwilling to set conditions on the European negotiating team regarding talks on Ukraine.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90111) reported that Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs warned during the Dublin summit that Russian President Vladimir Putin is using peace negotiations as a tactical maneuver to distract Europe from aid.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90109) reported that U.S. Special Envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner agreed to a Kremlin demand, giving Russian President Vladimir Putin room to stall peace negotiations over Ukraine.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/14/europe-taps-national-security-advisers-to-represent-the-continent-in-russia-ukraine-peace-talks) reported that national security advisers from the European Union, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Italy, and Poland will represent Europe in upcoming talks on ending the war.
On 14 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90104) reported that Poland was among the E5 countries selected to represent Europe at upcoming Ukraine peace negotiations.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxOZTRoMkNpSGIzbDhlUVh4c2FJWmU3eFNDbm56NndMNjl0MjN5WjQxbklnZ001cTVSdnR5LW40YXZCNHV1NV91SEF1am9KTnplZVNscHJ2MVUyQ3RJQ1ZGd21hWUVaUHBuNkVUZGhRNlB1VFhUeW5KR091TTRLeFhEcFBkVjNSNTNURXZMd2t5UHVxMXRFdXJHZHZKMHdxNThfZmZFUEhqLUdyejFKdy1MWXVOTDU4WkdDNTlIUUJDVTVLblptdmZ2eTVCNGFNUQ?oc=5), [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/russia-may-open-door-to-european-role-in-ukraine-peace-talks/) reported that EU leaders rejected a Russian push to include European security in Ukraine peace talks, while Russia signaled openness to European participation if Kyiv agrees to Kremlin demands.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/sviatlana-tsikhanouskaya-urges-europe-include-belarus-ukraine-peace-negotiations/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Belarusian dissident leader Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya wants Europe to consider Belarus in a broader Ukraine peace deal.

On 13 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckn80j9jv3jxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky welcomed the US bringing Europe into Russia-Ukraine peace talks.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/13/ukraine-war-briefing-europe-to-join-negotiations-says-kushner-as-putin-warns-against-peace-keepers) reported that Jared Kushner said the move will allow talks to address broader postwar European security arrangements.
On 13 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90082) reported that national security advisers from the EU and the E5 format will represent Europe in upcoming Russia-Ukraine peace talks.

On 13 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261113-europe-to-send-diplomats-from-across-the-continent-to-ukraine-peace-talks) reported that European Council President Antonio Costa stated that Brussels will send diplomats from the bloc and five countries, including the UK, France, Germany, Italy, and Poland.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062792/) reported that Politico stated EU leaders are close to agreeing on a negotiating team involving Germany, France, the UK, Italy, Poland, and EU institutions for talks on Ukraine.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062795/) reported that EU leaders agreed that Germany, France, the UK, Italy, Poland and EU institutions will represent Europe in negotiations.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/13/eu-leaders-bring-italy-and-poland-into-ukraine-peace-talks-team-as-kallas-fights-for-spot) reported that Europe decided on a joint team for the peace talks led by France, Germany, the UK, Italy, Poland, EU institutions, and NATO.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/13/russia-ukraine-talks-kaja-kallas-eu-foreign-policy-dublin-summit) reported that EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas warned that Moscow is setting traps in Ukraine talks.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/2026/11/12/putin-lets-europe-join-ukraine-peace-talks-as-kyiv-says-starshield-disrupted-again/), [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/13/putin-agrees-for-europe-to-join-ukraine-peace-talks-witkoff-says-a94236) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin agreed to allow European representatives to join the next round of Ukraine peace talks.

On 12 Nov 2026, [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/nx-s1-6038809/us-envoys-meet-putin-russia-ukraine-war-talks) NPR World reported that Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff went to the Kremlin to brief Russian President Vladimir Putin.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/85102112) reported that Moscow's proposals for a new European security order include demands for NATO to refrain from stationing military bases and for independence referendums in Gagauzia and Transnistria if Moldova joins the EU.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/12/kushner-and-witkoff-hold-talks-with-putin-before-heading-to-meet-zelensky-as-europe-seeks-a-seat-at-the-peace-talks) reported that U.S. presidential envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff flew to Moscow and met with Vladimir Putin at the Kremlin.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4184334-kallas-kushner-finally-admits-europe-must-help-shape-outcome-of-ukraine-peace-talks.html) reported that Kaja Kallas stated Europe must have a say in the outcome of Ukraine peace talks.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640123/russia-demands-finland-leave-nato-in-abu-dhabi-talks-report) reported that Russia demanded Finland leave NATO in Abu Dhabi talks.
On 13 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2217781) reported that the Kremlin stated there was no talk about NATO members' withdrawal from the alliance at the Abu Dhabi talks.

On 12 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/eu-leaders-tussle-over-whom-to-send-to-ukraine-russia-peace-talks/a-79935468?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that a seat at the table for Europe appears likely following comments by a US envoy who held talks with Putin, though who will take the seat remains unclear.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/12/8062612/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy met Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner at Casement Aerodrome near Dublin.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/6-killed-as-russia-ukraine-trade-accusations-after-abu-dhabi-talks-3725526) reported that Russia and Ukraine traded accusations over overnight airstrikes that killed at least six people following talks.

On 13 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261113-big-development-in-peace-talks-as-ukraine-says-europe-to-join-russia-negotiations) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and US envoy Jared Kushner stated that Europe would join the next round of talks with Russia.

On 13 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261113-eu-leaders-gather-in-dublin-as-ukraine-peace-talks-overshadow-ai-summit) reported that EU leaders gathered in Dublin on Friday for a summit dominated by efforts to secure Europe's place in negotiations to end the war in Ukraine.

On 12 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-12/news-1S0Uk2fR5pm/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that US envoys Witkoff and Kushner arrived at the Kremlin.
On 12 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2217341) reported that the meeting took place the day after the latest round of trilateral Russia-US-Ukraine talks concluded in Abu Dhabi.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/zelensky-warns-europe-over-us-russia-talks-on-broader-security-arrangements), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/89954) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned European leaders at the European Political Community Summit in Dublin about US-Russia talks on security arrangements.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-russia-s-vladimir-putin-suggests-no-ukraine-compromise-in-meeting-with-us-envoys) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin indicated that the Kremlin would not compromise on its hardline demands to end the war in Ukraine during a meeting with US envoys.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/12/war-in-ukraine-putin-meets-with-envoys-from-the-us-president/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned European leaders against discussions between the United States and Russia.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/12/us-envoys-meet-putin-at-kremlin-after-ukraine-talks-in-abu-dhabi/), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/us-envoys-meet-putin-at-kremlin-following-ukraine-talks-in-abu-dhabi/article71694418.ece) reported that during talks with US envoys, Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that Russia will target foreign troops in Ukraine and ruled out agreeing to foreign troops being stationed there.

On 13 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261113-live-zelensky-and-kushner-confirm-that-europe-will-join-next-round-of-russia-ukraine-talks), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckn80j9jv3jxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/world/europe/russia-ukraine-witkoff-kushner.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed European leaders will join the next round of peace talks.

On 12 Nov 2026, [RIA Novosti](https://ria.ru/20261112/putin-2131135070.html), [Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/11/12/putin-predlozhil-organizovat-gumanitarnuiu-missiiu-iz-konstantinovki-i-nazval-gosgranitsu-edinstvennoi-liniei-razgranicheniia-s-ukrainoi-news) reported that Vladimir Putin proposed organizing a humanitarian mission from Kostiantynivka during his meeting in the Kremlin.
On 12 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2216967) reported that senior diplomat Sergey Ryabkov stated Russia clearly laid out its position at the Abu Dhabi talks and expects a response.
On 12 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2216973) reported that Sergey Ryabkov addressed Europe's dejection, the Putin-Witkoff meeting, and Abu Dhabi outcomes.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/russia-and-ukraine-trade-strikes-as-peace-talks-end-with-little-progress/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Russia and Ukraine were targeted by mutual attacks hours after concluding trilateral peace talks mediated by the United States.

reports.text: On 14 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/14/world/europe/ukraine-starshield-zelensky.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated the system used to guide drones was being throttled over Russian-occupied territory.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/14/spacex-not-honest-slowing-starshield-elon-musk-volodymyr-zelenskyy) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused SpaceX of dishonesty regarding political reasons for slowing Starshield.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-live-trump-putin-zelensky-spacex-starshield-b3084909.html) reported that Moscow struck a hospital in central Kyiv.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/14/ukraine-war-briefing-zelenskyy-says-starshield-restrictions-continue-on-entire-front-line) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Starshield restrictions continue on the entire front line.

On 12 Nov 2026, [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/nx-s1-6038809/us-envoys-meet-putin-russia-ukraine-war-talks), [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-13/Putin-US-envoys-discuss-Ukraine-talks-as-positions-remain-divided-1S24FlpboIw/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin to discuss Ukraine talks.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90089) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated US-operated Starshield restrictions remain in place, limiting Ukraine's ability to intercept Russian drones.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/89977) reported that US Senators Jeanne Shaheen and Thom Tillis demanded that the Trump administration and SpaceX immediately restore Ukraine's Starshield satellite access.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062691/) reported that a bipartisan group of 105 House members asked the administration and SpaceX to explain why Starshield was restricted.

On 13 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2217901), a Russian state outlet, reported that Volodymyr Zelensky stated the US side offered no explanation for continued Starshield restrictions for Ukraine.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-seeks-explanation-on-starshield-speed-restrictions-from-us/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated the Starshield speed restrictions applied over Russian-occupied territory and along the front line.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/12/war-in-ukraine-putin-meets-with-envoys-from-the-us-president/) Africanews reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned European leaders against discussions between the United States and Russia.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062721/) Ukrainska Pravda reported that the Ukrainian president instructed officials to intensify contacts with the Pentagon and SpaceX as Starshield speed limits hinder military intelligence.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/12/zelensky-says-starshield-speed-limited-again-a94241) reported that Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Starshield speed was limited again, which helps Russians carry out more accurate strikes.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/zelenskiy-says-starshield-speed-limited-again-hampering-ukraines-defences), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/internationalrussia-ukraine-war/article-914688) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskiy said Ukrainian military units had recorded significant disruptions to Starshield satellite communications.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/12/us-envoys-in-moscow-meeting-putin-abu-dhabi-trilateral-ukraine-ceasefire-talks-latest-news-updates) reported that Ukraine's president stated unwelcome speed restrictions on military connectivity are helping Russians kill.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/12/8062470/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated deliberate 161 km/h speed caps on Starshield allowed Russian drone strikes to penetrate air defences over recent areas.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/12/zelensky-says-starshield-again-being-restricted-at-the-front) reported that Ukrainian military units observed significant malfunctions in Starshield satellite communications for several days.

reports.text: On 14 Nov 2026, [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/hungary-seizes-195-million-cash-hidden-forests-graft-probe.1137115) reported that Miklos Sesztak, two other ministers from Viktor Orban's cabinet, and his brother have been taken into custody in different cases.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/14/hungary-seizes-millions-in-cash-found-buried-in-forests-amid-corruption-investigation) reported that investigators uncovered large amounts of cash buried in forests, concealed in agricultural buildings, and stashed inside safes.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90112) reported that Hungary's National Asset Recovery and Protection Agency seized over 5 billion forints, €2.7 million, and $1.3 million in physical cash.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/hungarian-investigators-uncover-19-5m-hidden-in-forests-and-buildings?traffic_source=rss) reported that nearly $20 million was found in Hungary's forests and buildings amid a corruption probe into an ex-minister.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914852) reported that it took a dozen State Treasury workers eight hours to count the cash as part of Prime Minister Peter Magyar’s Operation Purgatory anti-corruption drive.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/13/hungary-seizes-195m-in-cash-found-buried-in-forests-amid-graft-inquiry), [Budapest Times](https://www.budapesttimes.hu/hungary/billions-in-buried-cash-found-in-forests-and-safes-in-ex-ministers-bribery-case/) reported that Hungary's anti-corruption agency seized $19.5 million in cash found buried in forests and safes as part of a bribery inquiry into an Orbán-era minister.

stories.label: Israel: Coalition Formation Talks and Political Transitions

reports.text: On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261114-netanyahu-renews-call-for-israeli-government-unity-as-eisenkot-dismisses-tricks), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/netanyahu-calls-for-israeli-unity-government-eisenkot-dismisses-tricks-3011919), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1114/1599234-netanyahu-renews-call-unity-government/) reported that Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu renewed his call for a national unity government with Gadi Eisenkot, who dismissed the appeal as tricks.
On 14 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-914874) reported that Netanyahu invoked the Hatikvah walkout and warned of Iran's nuclear threat.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/netanyahu-pushes-trump-iran-strikes-amid-mossad-us-visit) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu is pressing Donald Trump to renew attacks on Iran while Mossad chief Roman Gofman visits Washington.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-14/ty-article/.premium/after-briefing-eisenkot-netanyahu-urges-unity-government-without-preconditions/000001a1-db08-ddc9-abb7-dfca699e0000) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu invoked the threat from Iran and the need for national reconciliation in his appeal to Eisenkot.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-914878) reported that Eisenkot accused Netanyahu of political spin over his unity government appeal and demanded a break with extremists.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-14/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-calls-netanyahus-unity-plea-a-bluff/000001a1-db48-d59b-a1f3-dbdcd9bd0000) reported that Eisenkot called Netanyahu's unity plea a bluff and urged backing for Yashar's Knesset speaker pick.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-13/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-bloc-moves-to-undo-netanyahus-judicial-coup-through-knesset-committees/000001a1-d12f-da30-a7fb-d9bf1ba40000) reported that the Eisenkot bloc seeks to control key Knesset committees to undo Netanyahu's judicial coup.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-12/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-controls-the-knesset-netanyahu-is-still-pm-what-each-bloc-is-planning/000001a1-ce67-dfd7-a7a3-ce7757c70000) reported on what Eisenkot's bloc and Netanyahu's bloc are planning to do regarding the Knesset and government formation.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7177688) reported that Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz responded to Eisenkot by stating that Tel Aviv does not need the opposition's approval to continue operations in Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, and the West Bank.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190016/%D8%B4%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%B9-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B6%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B6%D9%81%D8%A9) reported that Hamas leader Abdul Rahman Shadid warned against the acceleration of land expropriation and settlement expansion in the West Bank.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxOR2xtdC1iNFRNSEZwNjVlM1hTeFVjREM0MlU4ZFlaWkVBYnQyNmxEdnZKeXRLQXBmbVVOeHI1U1l0TFN2cG1tQS02TFV0OElNUzhqZ1dRbUVfS3BtTVphOVFud1R6N1hZdGlpVl9GVE45dk93akNtcGRhUFB6cmpOd0FZbC1GOXBFendqUmtmalYwcUJybFo2WWRtOA?oc=5) reported that Israel's president gave Eisenkot the first chance to form the next government.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/11/israel-swears-in-new-parliament-as-netanyahu-remains-caretaker-pm/) reported that Gadi Eisenkot, tasked with forming a new Israeli government, pledged to reverse many of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's policies.

On 11 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/crime-in-israel/article-914571) reported that Amit Hadad, Netanyahu’s lawyer, stated that the judges could summon Baharav-Miara regardless of her position and that the door remains open to talks.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261111-netanyahu-rejects-palestinian-state-warns-of-iran-threat-and-calls-for-unity-government/) reported that outgoing Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu warned of potential international pressure on Israel to withdraw from territories it controls in Gaza.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-11/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-bloc-leaders-were-unaware-of-yashars-planned-talks-with-likud/000001a1-ca01-d1f4-a7f9-cac3d5240000) reported that Lieberman, Bennett and Golan learned of the planned Yashar-Likud talks only after they were canceled following Netanyahu's speech attacking Arab parties.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/11/netanyahu-heckled-by-bennett-at-knesset-opening-session?traffic_source=rss) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu was heckled by Naftali Bennett at the Knesset opening session.

On 10 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261110-eisenkot-pushes-october-7-inquiry-as-netanyahu-targets-arab-parties-in-tense-new-parliament) reported that Gadi Eisenkot pledged to launch an official inquiry into Hamas's October 7, 2023 attack.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/israel-politics-sara-netanyahu-heated-shouting-match-with-naftali-bennett-during-benjamin-netanyahus-knesset-address-101794372417173.html) reported that Naftali Bennett and Sara Netanyahu got into a heated exchange after the former questioned caretaker PM Benjamin Netanyahu about his Qatari advisers.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/unfit-to-remain-in-office-eisenkot-attacks-netanyahu-after-hateful-knesset-speech/articleshow/135722286.cms) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party cancelled a meeting with Netanyahu's Likud party after a hateful Knesset speech.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/eisenkot-vows-to-undo-netanyahu-policies-as-israeli-parliament-opens) reported that Israeli Prime Minister-designate Gadi Eisenkot pledged to dismantle key policies of outgoing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as the newly opened parliament began.

On 10 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261108-ex-army-chief-eisenkot-given-first-chance-to-form-government-in-israel) reported that former army chief Gadi Eisenkot was given the first chance to form Israel's next government after elections left neither main political bloc with a majority.

On 10 Nov 2026, [HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/israel-election-eisenkot-netanyahu_n_6aeff8afe4b0d2d11fa40151) reported that Israeli President Isaac Herzog tapped opposition candidate Gadi Eisenkot to form a governing coalition in a setback for Netanyahu.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/189964/%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%B1-%D8%A2%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%86%D9%83%D9%88%D8%AA-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%AD-%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%82%D9%8A%D9%82-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A5%D8%AE%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%AA-7-%D8%A3%D9%83%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%A8%D8%B1) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's 'Yashar' party submitted bills to the Knesset, led by establishing an official commission of inquiry into October 7 failures.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/elections/2026-11-10/ty-article/.premium/israels-new-knesset-sworn-in-as-eisenkot-seeks-to-form-government/000001a1-c600-d0f7-adfb-f721e5770000) reported that Israel's new Knesset was sworn in as Gadi Eisenkot seeks to form a government, while President Herzog urged lawmakers to compromise.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/who-matan-kahana-israels-proposed-new-knesset-speaker) reported that anti-Netanyahu bloc leaders agreed to nominate Matan Kahana as the new Knesset speaker.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-10/ty-article/.premium/arab-party-to-back-eisenkot-blocs-bid-to-replace-knesset-speaker/000001a1-c553-dba2-a9f9-d57fa5ce0000) reported that Arab-led Joint List lawmaker Ahmad Tibi said his party would back the Eisenkot bloc's Knesset speaker nominee.

On 10 Nov 2026, [New York Times World](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/world/middleeast/israel-parliament-eisenkot.html) reported that dozens of first-time lawmakers headed to the Knesset, where the opposition led by Gadi Eisenkot has a majority.

On 10 Nov 2026, [BBC World](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crd939lpzjp9o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, had the first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The Guardian World](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/gadi-eisenkot-netanyahu-allies-form-israel-government) reported that former military chief Gadi Eisenkot reached out to Netanyahu allies as he strived to form a government.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The Guardian World](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/07/israel-president-gadi-eisenkot-form-government) reported that Israel's president chose Yashar leader Gadi Eisenkot to form a government after the Knesset had been deadlocked.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2043517/new-israel-parliament-to-be-sworn-in-as-gadi-eisenkot-seeks-government) reported that Israel's new parliament was sworn in as Gadi Eisenkot works to form a government while Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu loses his majority.

On 9 Nov 2026, according to [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261109-former-israeli-prime-minister-barak-urges-eisenkot-to-accelerate-government-formation/), former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Barak urged Gadi Eisenkot to accelerate efforts to form a new government.

On 9 Nov 2026, The Jerusalem Post reported that Israeli President Isaac Herzog warned against the continuation of certain policies during a ceremony to officially task Gadi Eisenkot with forming a new government ([Naharnet](https://www.naharnet.com/stories/en/323654-herzog-tells-eisenkot-to-continue-negotiations-with-lebanon)).

On 9 Nov 2026, Middle East Monitor reported that members of Israel's Shas party are considering supporting an Eisenkot-led government if United Torah Judaism joins ([Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261109-shas-reportedly-open-to-supporting-eizenkot-led-government-if-united-torah-judaism-joins/)).

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/police-lift-evacuation-after-bomb-found-near-ethanol-plant-in-central-illinois-101794688737536.html) reported that police lifted evacuations after a bomb was found near an ethanol plant in central Illinois.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/residents-evacuated-after-bomb-found-at-illinois-ethanol-plant-fbi-joins-probe/articleshow/135837352.cms), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/peoria-bomb-threat-police-continue-search-for-more-explosives-at-biourja-plant-as-evacuation-order-remains-101794674711354.html) reported that police and the FBI are continuing their search for explosives at the BioUrja plant in Illinois where a bomb was found, while residents remain evacuated.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/14/peoria-illinois-evacuation-bomb) reported that Peoria officials stated a bomb was found at BioUrja Renewables and later defused, and the FBI said it is investigating.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxPSWRUeUVCV0dNLU1YTGo0NVF1QUVEZ0ZvRXhhcy1YX0wwTHpBUk4xTlpOaThuT3dURFY3MktkQ1oxajFpS3hlTHkwLTJubnlwd1JQSUIxUUdyTkM2Ymh3QWt1enJmb2FraVJXS3BOYmtNTExoT0lCR2N4QnpXRGVrYTIxdlhhNG1PUHJ6cDJVUQ?oc=5) reported that residents were evacuated after a bomb was found at an industrial plant in Illinois.

On 14 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/14/us/bomb-ethanol-plant-peoria-illinois.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/east-peoria-orders-one-mile-evacuation-after-bomb-threat-at-biourja-renewables-plant-in-illinois-101794626785566.html) reported that a bomb threat and suspicious package were found at the BioUrja Renewables ethanol plant in East Peoria, Illinois, prompting authorities to order a one-mile radius evacuation.

stories.title: US Air Force Responds to Suspicious Drone Activity at UK Base
stories.label: RAF Lakenheath drone activity

reports.text: On 14 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90107) reported that the U.S. Air Force responded to suspicious unauthorized drone activity over Royal Air Force Lakenheath in Suffolk.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914854) reported that the incident occurred weeks after U.S. bombers left RAF Fairford over security concerns and prosecutors alleged an Iranian intelligence link.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062817/) reported that US military personnel were ordered to shelter at RAF Lakenheath following suspected unauthorized drone activity.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/drone-sightings-trigger-security-response-at-us-airbase-in-britain-amid-spate-of-incidents/articleshow/135821301.cms) reported that significant security measures were enacted at Royal Air Force Lakenheath following reported drone activity.

stories.title: Paraguay’s ex-president Pena faces new charge over Ueno bank collapse
stories.label: Paraguay political and banking crisis

reports.text: On 14 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/fiscalia-paraguaya-acusa-asociacion-criminal-pena-cupula-bcp-caso-ueno-bank_1794677588) reported that Paraguayan prosecutor Christian Benítez stated a new charge of criminal association has been added against former president Santiago Peña and the Central Bank leadership in the Ueno bank case.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/how-a-bank-collapse-in-paraguay-brought-down-the-countrys-president-explained/article71677767.ece) reported that millions of customers abruptly lost access to savings and pension accounts after regulators seized a bank in Paraguay.

On 14 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-pena-criminal-association-ueno/), a state-media outlet, reported that Paraguay's Public Prosecutor's Office added a charge of criminal association as perpetrator against former president Santiago Peña.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/fiscalia-acusa-expresidente-paraguayo-pena-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal) reported that the prosecutor's office accused former Paraguayan president Peña of leading a criminal association, which carries a sentence of up to 15 years in prison.

On 13 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/milei-se-comunico-con-pedro-alliana-el-sucesor-de-santiago-pena-en-paraguay-nid13112026/) reported that Javier Milei communicated with Pedro Alliana, the successor of Santiago Peña, and expressed readiness to collaborate.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/crisis-en-paraguay-fiscalia-pide-ampliar-la-imputacion-contra-el-expresidente-santiago-pena-y-lo-acusa-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal-3600892), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-fiscalia-de-paraguay-complica-la-situacion-de-pena-con-una-nueva-imputacion-por-asociacion-nid13112026/), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/fiscalia-acusa-a-expresidente-paraguayo-de-liderar-asociacion-criminal-santiago-pena-protegio-desde-el-poder-a-ueno-bank-senala/) reported that the Paraguayan prosecutor's office expanded charges against former president Santiago Peña, accusing him of leading a criminal association and protecting Ueno Bank from power.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/santiago-pena-palacios-presidente-de-paraguay-sigue-la-pauta-destituido-y-en-la-carcel/) reported that regulators seized Ueno Bank, which managed about 850 million dollars in public funds.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-adds-prosecutors-ueno-bank-pena-investigations/) reported that Paraguay's attorney general Emiliano Rolón added two prosecutors to the Ueno Bank and Santiago Peña investigations.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-de-paraguay-allana-la-residencia-presidencial-por-escandalo-de-ueno-bank-33098347) reported that the Paraguayan justice system is carrying out two parallel investigations, one focused on Ueno Bank executives, 10 of whom are detained.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/paraguay-detienen-al-superintendente-de-bancos-por-caso-ueno-bank) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks was detained in connection with the Ueno Bank case following reports by prosecutors regarding operations without guarantees.

On 12 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/12/paraguay-s-banking-superintendent-arrested-in-the-ueno-bank-investigation?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/caso-ueno-bank-detuvieron-superintendente-bancos-paraguay_0_haEsfgaxKm.html) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks, Holger Insfrán, was arrested as part of the investigation into Ueno Bank.

On 11 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/ahorristas-bolivianos-ueno-bank-pueden-perder-12-dinero-tipo-cambio_1794364395) reported that Sergio León, director of the Bolivian-Paraguayan Chamber of Commerce, stated that Bolivian depositors in Ueno Bank can lose between up to 12% of their money due to the exchange rate.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/seguridad-social-paraguay-denuncia-ueno-bank-516-millones-dolares_1794351537) reported that Paraguay's social security denounced Ueno Bank for more than 516 million dollars, with President Pedro Alliana confirming the return of funds to public sector contributors.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/gobernante-partido-colorado-expulsa-santiago-pena-escandalo-ueno-bank_1794351056) reported that the ruling Colorado Party expelled Santiago Peña after the Ueno bank scandal.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/video-explica-crise-politica-e-bancaria-que-abala-o-paraguai-e-derrubou-presidente.shtml) reported that Paraguay is facing a political and financial crisis following the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left approximately 3 million clients affected.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/banco-central-revela-que-devolvio-ahorros-al-93-de-los-clientes-de-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-investigacion-continua/) reported that the Central Bank of Paraguay announced it returned savings to 93 percent of Ueno Bank clients while investigations continue.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/caso-ueno-deja-7-senales-alerta-vigilar-salud-bancos_1794326171) reported that banking expert Fabián Chaín warned that the Ueno case leaves seven warning signs to monitor the health of banks.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/iran-denies-role-in-cyberattacks-on-supermarket-refrigerators/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Iran denied any role in cyberattacks on French supermarket refrigerators.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Dagens Nyheter](https://www.dn.se/varlden/frankrike-hotar-med-vedergallning-mot-iran-efter-cyberattacker-utesluter-ingenting/) reported that France threatened retaliation against Iran and called for tougher EU sanctions against the regime in Tehran.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d9%81%d8%b1%d9%86%d8%b3%d8%a7-%d8%aa%d8%b3%d8%aa%d8%af%d8%b9%d9%8a-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b3%d9%81%d9%8a%d8%b1-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a5%d9%8a%d8%b1%d8%a7%d9%86%d9%8a-%d8%b9%d9%84%d9%89-%d8%ae%d9%84%d9%81%d9%8a) reported that France summoned the Iranian ambassador over cyberattacks targeting refrigeration systems in hundreds of stores and warned of a response.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/france-blames-iran-for-unprecedented-supermarket-fridge-cyberattack/) reported that France blamed Iran for the supermarket refrigerator cyberattack that spoiled produce at around 700 retailers and vowed sanctions.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/france-rules-out-nothing-in-response-to-irgc-supermarket-cyberattack-3725390) reported that French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot stated Paris rules out nothing in response to the cyberattack.

reports.text: On 14 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/nigeria-south-africa-diplomatic-row-deepens-as-fani-kayode-alleges-deliberate-blackout-at-diplomatic-ceremony/) reported that diplomatic tensions between Nigeria and South Africa deepened following allegations by Nigerian High Commissioner Femi Fani-Kayode of a deliberate livestream blackout at his diplomatic ceremony.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Mail & Guardian](https://mg.co.za/thought-leader/the-diplomat/2026-11-13-three-decades-one-melody-of-friendship-serbia-and-south-africa-celebrate-30-years-of-diplomatic-relations/) reported that Serbia and South Africa marked 30 years of diplomatic relations with a collaborative concert.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/ramaphosa-had-no-role-south-africa-accuses-fani-kayode-of-wrongly-linking-president-to-broadcast-blackout/) reported that South African Presidential Spokesperson Vincent Magwenya stated President Cyril Ramaphosa had no involvement in a broadcast disruption.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/924952-fani-kayode-presents-letter-of-credence-to-ramaphosa-formally-assumes-duty-as-ambassador.html) reported that Femi Fani-Kayode presented his Letter of Credence alongside ambassadors from 14 other countries and formally assumed duty as ambassador.

On 13 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/fani-kayode-presents-letter-of-credence-to-ramaphosa-pledges-to-rebuild-nigeria-south-africa-relations/) reported that Nigeria's High Commissioner to South Africa, Femi Fani-Kayode, presented his letter of credence to President Cyril Ramaphosa.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/fani-kayode-presents-letter-of-credence-to-ramaphosa-protests-livestream-omission/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Femi Fani-Kayode protested the exclusion of his speech from the livestream of the diplomatic ceremony.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/12/anc-vows-soul-searching-after-election-losses-but-says-ramaphosa-will-stay-put/) reported that leaders of South Africa's ruling African National Congress met to discuss the way forward after election losses and stated Ramaphosa will stay put.

On 13 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130034.html) reported that the MK party, EFF, and SACP formed a bloc called the Council of the Left representing 20 percent of the municipal vote, with conditional support for the ANC.

On 13 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/after-suffering-its-worst-election-result-what-s-next-for-the-anc-and-for-south-africa/a-79929902?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that a crushing local election result across South Africa left the ruling ANC searching for answers regarding public frustration.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/12/south-africas-anc-backs-ramaphosa-despite-local-election-losses/) reported that leaders of the African National Congress met to discuss the way forward after suffering a defeat at the ballot box.

On 12 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611120239.html) reported that about 138 municipalities in South Africa have no political party with enough seats to govern alone, forcing parties to negotiate agreements to share power.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/11/south-african-olympic-swimmer-switches-allegiance-to-the-netherlands/) reported that South African Olympic swimmer Tatjana Smith switched her allegiance to the Netherlands due to financial and practical challenges.

On 9 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20261109-south-africa-s-anc-slumps-to-worst-ever-election-result) reported that the African National Congress took just 30 percent of the votes in local elections, marking its worst electoral performance to date.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-10-from-475-to-325-the-ancs-local-government-slide-in-one-chart/) reported that the ANC's share of the local vote fell from 47.5% to 32.5%, while the MK entered at 9.9% and the DA rose to 22.9%.
